title: citrus × bergamia
intro: Citrus × bergamia, commonly known as bergamot, is a hybrid citrus plant that originates from Italy and is characterized by its small, green or yellowish-green fruit. The health benefits of bergamot include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and lower cholesterol levels. Bergamot oil, extracted from the rind of the fruit, exhibits therapeutic actions such as calming the mind, reducing anxiety and stress, and promoting relaxation due to its calming and sedative properties. The bioactive constituents of bergamot include bergamottin, bergapten, and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
